'''Dae'o Soset''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Soset offered his services to the Empire, serving as part of the [[Dread Executioners]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]] during the phase of the conflict known as the [[Dread War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dae'o Soset was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. He appeared on Oricon, where he was the Basic Gear vendor for the Bounty Hunter class. Soset and the rest of the class gear vendors at Oricon, along with all other Daily Areas and high-level planets, were replaced by standardized vendors in Game Update 4.0<ref name="TOR" /> on [[October 20]], [[2015]];<ref name="Patch4">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Soset was replaced by [[Mac Moria]].<ref name="TOR" />
